learning_outcomes.text: Get acquainted with a CAD design software
Obtain state-of-the-art specialized knowledge on the principles of design and manufacturing of two- and three-dimensional objects that consist the basis for innovative thinking
Obtain specialized skills in solving problems – required for research – such as skills in projecting and reproducing objects in space.
Have basic knowledge on 3D printing technology and methods

syllabus_topics: Design and rules of standardized mechanical elements
assessment_rules: Student evaluation is performed through three different procedures: during the lab via short-answer questions, problem solving, and laboratory work; a progress exam covering approximately half of the material; and a final exam. At the exams, students are expected to deliver 2D models in printable format according to engineering design rules and 3D models.
